learner_operation: Complete a monic quadratic with negative odd linear coefficient: infer the half, preserve value by adding/subtracting its square, factor, and combine the residual constant. Produce both numeric fragments; hard also requires signed parameters.

fixed_features.feature: Monic quadratic and negative odd integer linear term
fixed_features.justification: Target KP e-15021 and tutorial9421 teach the fractional-half completion for this sign. Varying to a nonmonic polynomial or solving an equation would add another operation.

fixed_features.feature: Two numeric blanks; factored sign support in easy/moderate
fixed_features.justification: Complete source q-223639/q-223640 explicitly supply signs. Both blanks still require calculation. Ordinary sampling uses this captured contract; full radio banks remain in source replay.

fixed_features.feature: Minus sign inside the completed square; hard a is negative
fixed_features.justification: Expanding (v-h)^2 with h>0 necessarily gives the negative linear term. Its fixed sign is a mathematical invariant, while its magnitude and the residual constant vary.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Odd m=3..15; variable rename irrelevant to numeric value.
answer_roles.observed: Fresh controls and boundary samples cover multiple halves; matched coefficient counterfactual changes both responses.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Negative, zero and positive; vary original c independently using integer/source-quarter profiles as well as near-square values.
answer_roles.observed: All three final bands include all three outcome signs after delivery. Catalog regression restores all five complete source polynomials and permits negative original constants in each band.

limitations: This finite audit challenges declared simple cues; it does not prove absence of every possible shortcut.

No ordinary answer banks exist; numerical rank, counterpart and modal-bank probes are inapplicable. All original radio banks are replayed and checked separately rather than claimed as a newly randomized radio family.
Only easy imported labels exist. Moderate/hard are authored support/response progressions, not empirical imported calibration.
Live learner history and changing inventory are outside the captured offline evidence. Selection conclusions are conditional on fresh usable candidates and configured band weights.
A genuine perfect-square cancellation can be recognized directly. That is valid completion knowledge; zero cases remain eligible.
